import pytest
from rich.console import Console
from rich.screen import Screen

def test_double_width_character_measurement():
    console = Console(width=10, height=5, legacy_windows=False)
    with console.capture() as capture:
        console.print(Screen("あ"))  # Using a double-width character
    result = capture.get()
    expected = "あ        \n"  # Expected output with correct measurement
    assert result == expected
